items.title: Holy Mass with the Music of St. Hildegard von Bingen
items.location: The Church of St. Rocco, 18 Third St., Glen Cove, NY, 7:00 pm
items.body: Music led by Dr. Christa Dalmazio and Mrs. Theresa Volpe. Following Mass, all are invited to light refreshments and a lecture on St. Hildegard by Dr. Dalmazio.

items.title: Featured by The Good Newsroom
items.body: The Archdiocese of New York's Good Newsroom visited Holy Innocents Parish to talk with Christa about living out her faith through sacred music.

items.title: Glorious Mystery now streaming
items.body: Six Marian chants recorded live at Holy Cross Church in Rumson, New Jersey, with Christa on harp, alongside soprano Dr. Carly York. Available on all major platforms.
